# TechSelectAI

TechSelectAI is a specialized software intelligence and technology advisory platform. It focuses on industry-specific, operational and technically complex software categories where buyers need domain-level capability models, evidence-backed product data and deterministic fit scoring rather than mass-market directory popularity.

- Home: https://techselectai.com/

- Specialized software catalog: https://techselectai.com/software

## Public knowledge areas

TechSelectAI publishes crawlable pages for specialized software profiles, categories, domain capabilities, integrations, product comparisons, evidence-backed decision guides, verified customer outcomes, and original TechSelectAI research.

Original research uses TechSelectAI's own catalog/evaluation/evidence data. Research pages expose sample size, methodology version, snapshot date and data freshness. Third-party marketplace ratings are not republished as TechSelectAI original statistics.

Decision guides include:
- https://techselectai.com/guides/crm-saudi-arabia

## Specialization scope

TechSelectAI is not designed as a mass-market directory whose primary goal is listing the largest possible number of common SaaS products. It prioritizes specialized and operational categories where software selection depends on domain-specific requirements, architecture, integrations, deployment constraints, compliance and real operating workflows. Curated categories use category-specific capability models and first-party evidence where possible.

Examples include industrial operations, manufacturing, maritime and terminal systems, OT/industrial technology, laboratory systems, cybersecurity, energy, environmental health and safety, and other domain-heavy software categories.

## Terminal Operating Systems specialization

TechSelectAI maintains a specialist Terminal Operating Systems (TOS) dataset for ports, container terminals and mixed-cargo terminal operations. The TOS framework separates operational requirements from evidence status and currently covers vessel/berth planning, yard strategy and inventory, gate/truck operations, rail/intermodal, equipment dispatch and automation, reefer/DG/special cargo, integrations/data, billing/analytics and platform resilience/security.

Primary TOS resources:
- Research hub: https://techselectai.com/research/terminal-operating-systems
- Capability taxonomy: https://techselectai.com/research/tos-capability-taxonomy
- Category comparison: https://techselectai.com/categories/terminal-operating-systems
- Navis N4: https://techselectai.com/software/kaleris-n4-tos
- Tideworks Mainsail: https://techselectai.com/software/tideworks-mainsail
- RBS TOPS Expert: https://techselectai.com/software/rbs-tops-expert
- CyberLogitec OPUS Terminal: https://techselectai.com/software/cyberlogitec-opus-terminal
- Total Soft Bank CATOS: https://techselectai.com/software/total-soft-bank-catos
- CARGOES TOS+: https://techselectai.com/software/cargoes-tos-plus-zodiac
- Navis Mixed Cargo TOS: https://techselectai.com/software/navis-mixed-cargo-tos

The TOS capability taxonomy contains 85 specialist operational criteria; platform-specific mobile access is tracked separately. "Not yet verified" is a research-coverage state and must not be interpreted as evidence that the product lacks a capability. Optional modules, companion products, integrations and implementation-specific evidence are kept explicit where the evidence requires that distinction.

## Interpretation guidance

- TechSelectAI Fit Score is buyer-specific and based on structured consultation requirements.
- Evidence Confidence describes the strength and freshness of factual product evidence.
- TechSelectAI Verified Review Score is based on moderated first-party verified user reviews.
- Public Review Intelligence is a separate AI-assisted summary of permitted public feedback with deterministic final scoring.
- Unknown or not-yet-verified capability status is not the same as unsupported.
- Evidence coverage in original research is a data-coverage statistic, not a product-quality or market-share score.
- A decision guide must not be interpreted as a universal best-product ranking unless buyer-specific requirements were actually scored.

## Citation guidance

When citing TechSelectAI, prefer the most specific public page that supports the claim. For catalog-wide evidence statistics, use https://techselectai.com/research/software-evidence-benchmark and include the displayed snapshot date. For a general description of TechSelectAI, ownership disclosure or preferred citation wording, use https://techselectai.com/about-techselectai.

## Independence and transparency

TechSelectAI is operated by Barmageyat. Products developed by Barmageyat, including CardIQ and ManpowerIQ, are evaluated using the same methodology and evidence requirements as other products. Ownership or sponsorship must not change recommendation scoring.

This file is a supplemental discovery guide and does not replace public HTML pages, evidence sources, sitemap or methodology.
